name: Olivia
quote: Bullets fly, and flames bathe the world.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor. I've finished organizing the operation records, so please take a look. As for sector construction, though... it's not my area of expertise, so I'll need your guidance.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Thank you for the invitation, but I'll just have rations for lunch... No, actually, please take me to the cafeteria to eat with everyone. Things related to daily life like this... are exactly what I—what we—lack.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: A night with no need for vigilance, free to relax. The Oasis really is a wonderful place... I think I'll rest a little too.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: You're still working at this hour? Even on the front lines, proper rest is essential. Hmm... How about this: we take turns finishing the rest?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Cyclopes Sector has two types of Agents: Combat-type Agents that test combat data, and Monitor-Type Agents that monitor and command them. To manage the sector better, the administrator authority was split in two as well. I'm the Monitor-Type administrator, and Tasha... the other "me" was the Combat-type administrator... But now, I'm the only administrator of Cyclopes.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text:
As the sector's administrator, I have to stay calm and lead everyone in rebuilding Cyclopes Sector. Whenever my emotions waver, I unconsciously touch the gun in my hand. The cold metal works like a sedative, calming me down and letting me reflect and sort out my thoughts... Eek?! Cold!
Professor, you put that ice-cold soda on my neck on purpose, didn't you? If you do it again, we'll have to talk about this gun's other use.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: ...Mm... Did I fall asleep...? Huh? You too, Professor... Hehe, what a peaceful sleeping face. So this is a peaceful world... Was I making that same expression just now?

voices.label: Home Screen 4
voices.text: Simo... It seems he's completely shed the name Gaul.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: I don't have any missions to carry out right now... Professor, could you show me around the Oasis?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Equipment check complete.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Eek! ...Oh, it's you, Professor. Ahem... Please forget that reaction.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Professor, bullets show no mercy.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: On-duty observation, huh... Now that I think about it, it's been a long time since I came back from the front lines.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Cyclopes Sector Administrator—Olivia. For the future and peace of Magrasea, and for the promise I made to my fallen comrades, I will never run from this fight. Professor, allow me to fight by your side.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Valuable combat experience... I see...

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Combat data analysis complete. It will surely be put to use in the next battle.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: With this power, we'll break the loop of slaughter and march toward Cyclopes's tomorrow.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: This is Olivia, preparing to enter the battlefield.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: All units, prepare for battle.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: All units, covering fire—FIRE!!!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Attention all combatants: battle over. Good work.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Stay alert, check supplies, prepare for the next battle.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: We haven't yet achieved... our... dream...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
A-an oath? With me? P-Professor, are you sure? I'm... not a Doll, but an Agent born for Cyclopes Sector. The only place I can exist is... this Cloud... I can't live in the same world as you.
...What I truly feel in my heart... Phew... Cyclopes Monitor-Type Administrator, model G22 OLIVIA, accepts the oath offered by <cmdr>! From now on, I will share in <cmdr>'s joys and hardships. Huh? Too formal...? Th-then... let me say how I feel more simply. I love you, Professor. I accept your oath.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: That sound... fireworks? For us, born in Cyclopes, gunpowder had only one use: taking others' lives. But here it means something different... flowers of light blooming in celebration. I hope that someday flowers with such a beautiful meaning will bloom in Cyclopes too. I look forward to the new year with you, Professor.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text:
P-Professor, Happy Valentine's Day... This is chocolate I made for you. It's my first time making chocolate for someone, so the taste might be lacking. If you don't mind, I'd like to hear what you think after you try it. Hm? It's missing a little something? A spell to make it tasty?
Fluffy-wuffy, sweet and sugary, chocolate~ please be yummy~
...Professor, that expression... you're definitely teasing me...

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text:
Lovers separated by the Milky Way... We weren't lovers, but I too was once forced apart from someone important to me. It wasn't allowed, and we couldn't see each other. Professor, I sincerely hope nothing like that ever happens to you.
Huh... Would it hurt me too if we were separated? Of course it would, you're important to me too, Professor. Hm? Why did Miss Persicaria walk past with such a grave look... Did I say something strange?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text:
Professor, Cyclopes Sector has received your invitation and come to join the Halloween festivities. But we'd like to ask... what kind of holiday is Halloween, exactly? Huh? G-ghosts?!
P-Professor, about the Cyclopes Agents joining the Oasis Halloween parade today... if possible, please look after them. M-me? I'll head back to Cyclopes Sector first... I don't think this holiday suits me... Eek!!!
G22 OLIVIA, system overload, restarting...

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Professor, Merry Christmas. This is your present, please accept it. In human history, there was a miracle called the Christmas Truce. No killing, no shelling, just ordinary people who couldn't go home, remembering the past year and praying for the new one. Professor, I hope you spend the new year in peace, happiness, safety and joy as well.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy birthday, Professor. This is a cake I made myself... it might be shaped a little strangely. D-don't laugh... In the old Cyclopes, no one cared when a comrade was born, nor when a comrade died. Everyone was just a killing machine. But after meeting you, Cyclopes changed. Thank you so much, Professor.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: There are always flowers in bloom at the Oasis... Ah, sorry. I got lost staring at the flowers. I love flowers. Even in a war-torn sector like Cyclopes, they still bloom stubbornly in the cracks. I believe that someday Cyclopes will be surrounded by blooming flowers just like the Oasis. When that day comes, please be sure to visit Cyclopes, Professor.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: The base code of every Agent in Cyclopes comes from one Doll's combat data. You could say each Agent in Cyclopes is one branch of his possibilities. But... to him, we were probably the worst possible outcome. Yet that Doll has now cut his own chains and been reborn under your guidance. Thank you, Professor. Seeing Simo by your side makes me truly happy. Because it proves that fighting isn't our only way to live... We have more choices. We used to be Simo's possibilities. And now Simo... is Cyclopes's possibility.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: Hm? I've been smiling more lately... Have I? So I can make this kind of expression naturally now. To rebuild Cyclopes, to break the loop of slaughter, for the vow I made that day... I had to stop Cyclopes from tearing itself apart through action, down to the smallest detail... even just a smile that puts everyone at ease. But for someone born to fight like me... smiling was very hard. No matter how many times I practiced alone in front of the mirror, it still felt awkward... nowhere near a smile that makes people feel at ease... Huh? My smile is captivating and beautiful...? Thank you, Professor.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: "Don't enter the loop of slaughter again..." Those were her last words. She hoped I would never reset her, because she had already fulfilled our dream. But when I came to the Oasis and began rebuilding Cyclopes, I had a new thought... Our dream absolutely doesn't stop at cutting the loop of slaughter. Professor, I'll keep fighting. For our tomorrow, for our dream, I'll keep fighting. I believe that when true peace finally comes... that will be the view Tasha wanted to see. Professor, if possible... I'd like you to witness that day with me. Without your help and guidance, we would never have had such a possibility.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text: At first, when I learned you were human, I had some doubts. Especially when I saw how you command Dolls in battle... I was very worried that you might be just like the humans who designed us. But after fighting side by side with you, I understood why Simo made the choice he did... You've never treated us as weapons, but as comrades, partners, even family. You have such a strong military air, yet you often act unlike a soldier... I really like that about you. Fighting alongside a human like you is my greatest honor. If someday... I also get the chance to go to the real world, I'd like to keep moving forward with you, under your command. Hm? Why is your face red, Professor? Did I say something... Ah... N-no, I meant as partners... ah... Calm down, Olivia, calm down... Phew... Anyway, thank you, Professor!

career:
G22 OLIVIA, codename "Olivia," is the current administrator of the military sector "Cyclopes." G22-type Agents possess larger and more complex mind computation structures than ordinary Agents, enabling them to handle ever-evolving, increasingly precise military technology roles. Compared to other G22-type Agents, Olivia specializes in command, control and intelligence, and showed outstanding performance in testing, which led to her selection as an administrator of Cyclopes Sector alongside G22 TASHA.

After a series of upheavals, Olivia took on the duties of sector administrator alone and established a friendly, cooperative relationship with the Oasis. Inheriting the will of her fallen colleague, she led the reconstruction of Cyclopes, achieving marked improvements in inter-sector exchange and technological level, and later demonstrated formidable ability during a series of major crises in Magrasea.
infoStories:
The administrator role of the military sector "Cyclopes" is likewise filled by Agents with high mind levels appointed by humans. But the sector's greatest peculiarity is its unique "multi-administrator" system, reminiscent of the co-rule systems of old.

The G-series Agents who serve as administrators were also created with a special purpose. Cyclopes Sector stores a vast amount of data on military technology. Over thousands of years, warfare has grown into an immense and highly complex discipline that has driven many of humanity's technological breakthroughs. Beyond the evolution of weapons, tactical and strategic command, intelligence, artificial intelligence, and even mass media and psychology research have all become part of modern military science.

Having a single Agent oversee all of this is clearly impractical; even 42Lab, a leader in AI technology, would struggle. So Svarog Heavy Industries derived multiple sub-models from the mind model of a proven, battle-tested combat Doll, "Gaul," to integrate and manage different fields. This is why the G-series Agents were born and why Cyclopes Sector adopted a multi-administrator system. The G22 series is the result of the 22nd iteration, its full name being "Gaul MK-22."

One of the special G22 units, the Monitor-Type G22 OLIVIA focuses on command, control and intelligence. The Combat-type G22 TASHA, also a special unit, focuses on battlefield tactics and weaponry.

"When it comes to killing people as efficiently as possible, scorching farmland and enslaving the conquered, humanity possesses an almost omniscient and omnipotent creativity."
—A message found in the deep database of Cyclopes Sector. Author unknown.

Cyclopes Sector not only stored military data gathered from around the world, but also carried the mission of designing a new generation of all-terrain military Dolls. After weighing potential, compatibility and cost, Cyclopes Sector once again used the mind model of the combat Doll "Gaul" to create a large number of experimental Agents. Under the leadership of the Monitor-Type and Combat-type administrators, they ran experiments simulating every battlefield in the database.

Following Svarog's instructions, the two administrators successfully conducted numerous simulations and produced excellent results. But during the final experiment, Cyclopes Sector never received the order to end it, and the Svarog personnel in charge stopped responding to the administrators' messages. The only instruction left was: "Maintain the original plan. Await new orders."

Endless combat and resets beyond the design limit eventually caused errors in the Combat-type Agents' minds. These errors gradually affected the minds of administrators Tasha and Olivia as well, and in the end, the two parted ways.

During the turmoil in Cyclopes Sector, Combat-type administrator Tasha fell in battle, and Monitor-Type administrator Olivia became the sole administrator. Tasha's death dealt Olivia a heavy blow; the two may have opposed each other in many ways, but their fundamental beliefs were the same. From then on, Olivia shouldered the duties of Cyclopes's administrator alone, forced to take on things she wasn't good at while cleaning up the mess within the sector: allocating operands for reconstruction, calming public sentiment, external diplomacy, and most importantly, dealing with the opposition Agents loyal to Tasha who were hostile toward her.

During that time, Olivia poured nearly all her time into work, and her mind overloaded more and more often. At first she was quite clumsy in some areas, even causing the opposite of what she intended. Over time, she gradually adjusted, reflected on her problems and stepped out of the shadow, receiving more and more help from inside and outside the sector, especially from the Oasis.

Reconstruction slowly got on track. The opposition Agents may still harbor resentment, but under the banner of rebuilding, they gradually came to accept their new leader. In a sense, Cyclopes Sector truly did change in Olivia's hands. The Agents began to manage and build their own "home" with their newly sprouting free will. And just as Tasha had said, a sector built on warfare began, little by little, to escape the loop of slaughter.

In the past, Olivia was described as "very capable, but lacking a leader's dignity and presence," in stark contrast to Tasha. In the course of overseeing the sector's reconstruction, Olivia's outward image changed markedly along with her mindset.

While not as excessively strict as Tasha, Olivia now possesses a leader's presence to some degree, and her speech and expressions have become calmer and steadier. In private, however, she's hardly changed at all; she's more or less the same as she always was. She has tried to change her private image, but usually gives up because it feels too unfamiliar and awkward. Still, there are occasional exceptions.

According to unreliable records, Olivia once bought a mind projection of a skirt and high heels at Riko's urging, to attend a gathering in another sector. But having no experience with such things, along with strong inner resistance, she ended up throwing a thick coat and hat over it, and was mistaken by Agents on the street for some oddball from Burbank. In the end, this mind projection was mercilessly deleted along with any record of Olivia attending the gathering, and after agonizing over what to wear, Olivia rarely attended other sectors' gatherings again.

After Olivia became the sole administrator, ties between Cyclopes Sector and the Oasis grew closer by the day, and the two helped each other through many major crises. Beyond shared interests, the personal friendships Olivia formed with key figures of the Oasis, including the Professor, are an important factor in their relationship.

Once Cyclopes entered a stable period and Olivia gradually had more free time, she often visited the Oasis in a private capacity. Besides some key business, it was a chance to briefly escape her work and rest, and to meet her old friends—mainly the Professor.

Occasionally Olivia sneaks off to Burbank alone. She doesn't seem used to its free-wheeling, decadent atmosphere, but she always manages to find a quiet bar counter to spend some time at, deep in thought—or thinking about nothing at all.

Born from the rust of war, inheriting the will of the late Tasha, and forming deep bonds with new companions, she will continue to lead Cyclopes forward for the foreseeable future, until someone capable of succeeding her and earning the people's support appears. Here, her role is that of a leader who bears much and must keep growing. And outside of that, she will keep walking on as her true self.
oathDesc: For those who we cannot forget. From now on, we fight together.
